title: I made a video game with Claude in 2 days with no experience...
author: RetroIcon
selftext:
Marble Hopper Online is a 3D marble racing board game. You roll the dice, move your marble around the board, and the first player home wins. It has local and online multiplayer, private matches, a friends list, leaderboards, challenges, and achievements. It runs in a browser on both mobile and PC.

I built the whole thing with Claude, and it was my first game. I started with no development experience. Claude told me which programs to install, wrote the code, and built the menus and visuals after I uploaded a few reference images. Two playable boards were working within two days. Over the next four days we built the web version and the online features. The total was about six days.

It’s free to play in your browser with no download: [https://nickedstudios.itch.io/marble-hopper-online](https://nickedstudios.itch.io/marble-hopper-online)

I’d love feedback on the game, and I’m happy to answer questions about the process of building it with Claude. (Mostly using Opus5.5 and Unity) AI is incredible with it's speed in which we can watch our imaginations come to life.
